name: Grant on Passing the Written Examination of Competitive Examinations for Recruitment in Armed Forces
benefit: - A one-time grant of ₹15,000/- is provided to children of ex-serviceman who pass the written examination of CDS, NDA, IMA, OTA, Air Force, or Naval Academy, for the purpose of coaching.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be the child of an ex-serviceman.
1. The applicant should have passed the written examination of NDA, CDS, IMA, OTA, Air Force, or Naval Academy.
